label: Desktop
html:
<style>
  /* the desktop: the scaffold's own glue - shell, wallpaper, taskbar and the
     apps' layouts. Windows, menus, flyout contents and dialogs are the shipped
     components (Window, Menubar, Dropdown, Context Menu, Tabs, Calendar,
     Toggle, Slider, Switch, Radio, Select, Dialog, Alert Dialog, Spinner,
     Toast) - and the browser's sites are the Website blocks */
  .os {
    --os-tb: 3rem;
    --os-accent: oklch(0.58 0.17 250);
    --os-glass: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 72%, transparent);
    --os-icon: 2.75rem;
    container: os / inline-size;
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: var(--scaffold-height, 50rem);
    overflow: hidden;
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    filter: brightness(var(--os-bright, 1));
    --primary: var(--os-accent);
    --ring: var(--os-accent);
  }
  .os[data-accent='purple'] {
    --os-accent: oklch(0.56 0.2 300);
  }
  .os[data-accent='green'] {
    --os-accent: oklch(0.58 0.15 155);
  }
  .os[data-accent='orange'] {
    --os-accent: oklch(0.66 0.17 50);
  }
  .os[data-accent='pink'] {
    --os-accent: oklch(0.6 0.2 355);
  }
  .os:not([data-glass]) {
    --os-glass: var(--background);
  }
  .dark .os {
    --os-glass: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 68%, transparent);
  }
  .dark .os:not([data-glass]) {
    --os-glass: var(--background);
  }
  .os[data-night]::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 50;
    background: oklch(0.75 0.12 60 / 0.18);
    mix-blend-mode: multiply;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* wallpapers */
  .os-wall-layer,
  .os-wall-thumb {
    background: var(--os-wall);
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center;
  }
  .os-wall-layer {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    transition: opacity 400ms ease;
  }
  [data-wallpaper='bloom'],
  [data-wall='bloom'] {
    --os-wall:
      radial-gradient(60% 80% at 70% 60%, oklch(0.62 0.2 265) 0%, transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(50% 70% at 30% 40%, oklch(0.72 0.14 220) 0%, transparent 65%),
      linear-gradient(160deg, oklch(0.85 0.06 230), oklch(0.55 0.15 260));
  }
  .dark [data-wallpaper='bloom'],
  .dark [data-wall='bloom'] {
    --os-wall:
      radial-gradient(60% 80% at 70% 60%, oklch(0.45 0.2 270) 0%, transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(50% 70% at 30% 40%, oklch(0.4 0.14 230) 0%, transparent 65%),
      linear-gradient(160deg, oklch(0.25 0.05 250), oklch(0.18 0.06 270));
  }
  [data-wallpaper='aurora'],
  [data-wall='aurora'] {
    --os-wall:
      radial-gradient(70% 50% at 30% 30%, oklch(0.7 0.17 160 / 0.9), transparent 70%),
      radial-gradient(60% 50% at 75% 45%, oklch(0.55 0.2 300 / 0.85), transparent 70%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, oklch(0.2 0.05 260), oklch(0.12 0.03 260));
  }
  [data-wallpaper='lake'],
  [data-wall='lake'] {
    --os-wall: url('https://picsum.photos/seed/os-lake/1920/1080') center / cover, oklch(0.6 0.08 220);
  }
  [data-wallpaper='dunes'],
  [data-wall='dunes'] {
    --os-wall: url('https://picsum.photos/seed/os-dunes/1920/1080') center / cover, oklch(0.7 0.08 60);
  }

  /* the desktop area: windows over the icon surface, above the taskbar */
  .os .os-desktop {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0 0 var(--os-tb) 0;
    min-height: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    background: none;
  }
  .os-surface {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
  }
  .os .window[data-minimized] {
    display: none;
  }
  .os .window {
    animation: os-pop 160ms ease both;
  }
  @keyframes os-pop {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      scale: 0.97;
    }
  }
  .os-icons {
    display: grid;
    grid-auto-flow: column;
    grid-template-rows: repeat(auto-fill, var(--os-cell-h));
    grid-auto-columns: var(--os-cell-w);
    gap: 0.25rem;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    align-content: start;
    transition: opacity 150ms ease;
    --os-cell-w: 5.5rem;
    --os-cell-h: 5.75rem;
  }
  .os[data-icons='large'] .os-icons {
    --os-icon: 3.75rem;
    --os-cell-w: 7rem;
    --os-cell-h: 7.25rem;
  }
  .os[data-icons='small'] .os-icons {
    --os-icon: 2rem;
    --os-cell-w: 4.5rem;
    --os-cell-h: 4.5rem;
  }
  .os[data-right] .os-icons {
    direction: rtl;
    & .os-icon {
      direction: ltr;
    }
  }
  .os:not([data-showicons]) .os-icons {
    visibility: hidden;
  }
  .os-icons[data-refresh] {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  .os-icon {
    display: grid;
    justify-items: center;
    align-content: start;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding: 0.375rem 0.25rem;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: none;
    color: #fff;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-align: center;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.6);
    cursor: default;
    & .os-tile {
      width: var(--os-icon);
      height: var(--os-icon);
      border-radius: 22%;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.25);
    }
    & > span:last-child {
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }
    &:hover {
      background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.14);
    }
    &[aria-selected='true'] {
      border-color: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.45);
      background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--os-accent) 40%, transparent);
    }
    &:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid #fff;
      outline-offset: 1px;
    }
  }
  .os-tile {
    display: inline-grid;
    place-items: center;
    flex: none;
    width: 2rem;
    height: 2rem;
    border-radius: 0.5rem;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--t) 80%, white), var(--t));
    color: #fff;
    & svg {
      width: 55%;
      height: 55%;
    }
  }
  .os-file {
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, oklch(0.98 0 0), oklch(0.9 0.01 250));
    color: var(--t);
  }

  /* windows: app icons and the active title */
  .os-wicon {
    display: inline-grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 1.125rem;
    height: 1.125rem;
    border-radius: 0.25rem;
    background: var(--t);
    color: #fff;
    & svg {
      width: 0.75rem;
      height: 0.75rem;
    }
  }
  .os-dirty {
    display: none;
    margin-inline-end: 0.375rem;
    color: var(--os-accent);
    font-size: 0.625rem;
    vertical-align: 0.125rem;
  }
  .os-editor[data-dirty] .os-dirty {
    display: inline;
  }

  /* the taskbar */
  .os-taskbar {
    position: absolute;
    inset: auto 0 0 0;
    z-index: 30;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: var(--os-tb);
    padding-inline: 0.5rem 0;
    border-block-start: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border) 70%, transparent);
    background: var(--os-glass);
    backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.4);
  }
  .os-tb-apps {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.125rem;
  }
  .os[data-taskbar='left'] .os-tb-apps {
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }
  .os-tb-btn {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    min-width: 2.5rem;
    height: 2.5rem;
    padding: 0 0.375rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: none;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    cursor: default;
    & > svg {
      width: 1.125rem;
      height: 1.125rem;
    }
    &:hover {
      background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent);
    }
    &:active {
      scale: 0.96;
    }
    &:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--os-accent);
      outline-offset: -2px;
    }
    & .os-tile {
      width: 1.625rem;
      height: 1.625rem;
      border-radius: 0.4375rem;
    }
  }
  .os-start-btn {
    color: var(--os-accent);
    & svg {
      width: 1.375rem;
      height: 1.375rem;
    }
  }
  .os-tb-app[data-unpinned]:not([data-running]) {
    display: none;
  }
  .os-tb-app::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0.125rem;
    left: 50%;
    width: 0;
    height: 0.1875rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--muted-foreground);
    translate: -50% 0;
    transition: width 150ms ease;
  }
  .os-tb-app[data-running]::after {
    width: 0.375rem;
  }
  .os-tb-app[data-active] {
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 9%, transparent);
    &::after {
      width: 1rem;
      background: var(--os-accent);
    }
  }
  .os-tray {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    height: 100%;
  }
  .os-tray-icons {
    gap: 0.5rem;
    & svg {
      width: 1rem;
      height: 1rem;
    }
  }
  .os-vol > svg {
    display: none;
  }
  .os-vol[data-vol='0'] > svg:nth-child(1),
  .os-vol[data-vol='1'] > svg:nth-child(2),
  .os-vol[data-vol='2'] > svg:nth-child(3) {
    display: block;
  }
  .os-clock {
    display: grid;
    justify-items: end;
    gap: 0;
    padding-inline: 0.5rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    & small {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
    }
  }
  .os-show-desktop {
    width: 0.5rem;
    height: 100%;
    margin-inline-start: 0.25rem;
    border: 0;
    border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: none;
    cursor: default;
    &:hover {
      background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent);
    }
  }

  /* flyouts (start, quick settings, calendar) - our own placement above the taskbar */
  .os-flyout {
    position: fixed;
    inset: auto;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border) 80%, transparent);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--os-glass);
    color: var(--foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-2xl);
    backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(1.5);
    overflow: hidden;
    transition:
      opacity 160ms ease,
      translate 160ms ease,
      overlay 160ms allow-discrete,
      display 160ms allow-discrete;
    opacity: 0;
    translate: 0 0.75rem;
    &:popover-open {
      opacity: 1;
      translate: 0 0;
    }
    @starting-style {
      &:popover-open {
        opacity: 0;
        translate: 0 0.75rem;
      }
    }
  }
  .os-start {
    left: 50%;
    bottom: calc(var(--os-tb) + 0.75rem);
    width: min(40rem, calc(100vw - 1.5rem));
    max-height: min(44rem, calc(100vh - 5rem));
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    translate: -50% 0.75rem;
    &:popover-open {
      display: flex;
      translate: -50% 0;
    }
    @starting-style {
      &:popover-open {
        translate: -50% 0.75rem;
      }
    }
  }
  .os-start[data-left] {
    left: 0.75rem;
    translate: 0 0.75rem;
    &:popover-open {
      translate: 0 0;
    }
  }
  .os-quick,
  .os-cal {
    right: 0.75rem;
    bottom: calc(var(--os-tb) + 0.75rem);
  }
  /* toasts land above the taskbar */
  .toast-container[data-position^='bottom'] {
    bottom: 3rem;
  }
  .os-start-search {
    position: relative;
    margin: 1.5rem 2rem 1rem;
    & svg {
      position: absolute;
      inset-inline-start: 0.875rem;
      top: 50%;
      translate: 0 -50%;
      width: 1rem;
      height: 1rem;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
    }
    & .input {
      height: 2.5rem;
      padding-inline-start: 2.5rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--background);
    }
  }
  .os-start-home,
  .os-start-results {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 0 2rem 1rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
  .os-start-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin: 0.5rem 0.5rem 0.5rem;
    & h2 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    & .btn svg {
      width: 0.75rem;
      height: 0.75rem;
    }
  }
  .os-pinned {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(5.5rem, 1fr));
    gap: 0.25rem;
    margin-block-end: 1rem;
  }
  .os-app {
    display: grid;
    justify-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    padding: 0.625rem 0.25rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: none;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    cursor: default;
    & .os-tile {
      width: 2.25rem;
      height: 2.25rem;
    }
    &:hover,
    &:focus-visible {
      background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 7%, transparent);
      outline: none;
    }
  }
  .os-recent,
  .os-result-list {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(14rem, 1fr));
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }
  .os-recent-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: none;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    text-align: start;
    cursor: default;
    & > span:last-child {
      display: grid;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    & strong {
      overflow: hidden;
      font-weight: 500;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    & small {
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
    }
    &:hover,
    &:focus-visible,
    &[data-first] {
      background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 7%, transparent);
      outline: none;
    }
  }
  .os-start-foot {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0.75rem 2rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 50%, transparent);
  }
  .os-me {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.625rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .os-quick {
    width: 22rem;
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1.25rem;
    &:popover-open {
      display: flex;
    }
  }
  .os-qs-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 0.625rem;
  }
  .os-qs {
    display: grid;
    justify-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    height: auto;
    padding: 0.75rem 0.25rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--background);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    & svg {
      width: 1.125rem;
      height: 1.125rem;
    }
    &[aria-pressed='true'] {
      border-color: var(--os-accent);
      background: var(--os-accent);
      color: #fff;
    }
  }
  .os-qs-slider {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    & > svg {
      width: 1.125rem;
      height: 1.125rem;
      flex: none;
    }
    & .slider {
      flex: 1;
    }
  }
  .os-qs-foot {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin: 0 -1.25rem -1.25rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 50%, transparent);
    & span {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.375rem;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
    }
    & svg {
      width: 1rem;
      height: 1rem;
    }
  }
  .os-cal {
    width: 20rem;
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 1rem 1rem 0.5rem;
    &:popover-open {
      display: flex;
    }
    & .calendar {
      border: 0;
      background: none;
      box-shadow: none;
      padding: 0;
    }
  }
  .os-cal-time {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .os-cal-date {
    margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
    color: var(--os-accent);
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .os-ctx {
    min-width: 14rem;
    & .context-menu-item {
      gap: 0.625rem;
    }
    & svg {
      width: 0.9375rem;
      height: 0.9375rem;
    }
  }
  .os-ctx .context-menu-item[aria-checked] {
    position: relative;
    padding-inline-end: 2rem;
  }
  .os-ctx .context-menu-item[aria-checked='true']::after {
    content: '✓';
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline-end: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--os-accent);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .os-menu-heading {
    margin: 0.375rem 0.5rem 0.25rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  /* editor */
  .os-ed-body {
    display: flex;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .os-ed-text {
    flex: 1;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    border: 0;
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--card-foreground);
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: calc(0.875rem * var(--os-zoom, 1));
    line-height: 1.6;
    resize: none;
    outline: none;
  }
  .os-editor[data-nowrap] .os-ed-text {
    white-space: pre;
    overflow-wrap: normal;
    overflow-x: auto;
  }
  .os-editor[data-nostatus] .os-ed-status {
    display: none;
  }
  .os-ed-status {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1.25rem;
    & span:first-child {
      flex: 1;
    }
  }
  .os-saveas-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-block-start: 0.375rem;
    & .input {
      flex: 1;
    }
  }
  .os-saveas {
    width: min(26rem, calc(100% - 2rem));
  }

  /* calculator */
  .os-calc-body {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 60%, var(--card));
  }
  .os-calc-display {
    display: grid;
    justify-items: end;
    padding: 0.75rem 0.75rem 0.5rem;
    min-height: 5.5rem;
  }
  .os-calc-expr {
    min-height: 1.25rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  .os-calc-value {
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .os-calc-value[data-long] {
    font-size: 1.75rem;
  }
  .os-calc-keys {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }
  .os-key {
    height: 2.75rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .os-key[data-variant='outline'] {
    background: var(--card);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  /* browser */
  .os-br-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.125rem;
  }
  .os-br-address {
    position: relative;
    flex: 1;
    margin-inline: 0.375rem;
    & > svg {
      position: absolute;
      inset-inline-start: 0.75rem;
      top: 50%;
      translate: 0 -50%;
      width: 0.875rem;
      height: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
    }
    & .input {
      height: 2rem;
      padding-inline-start: 2rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 70%, transparent);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
    }
  }
  .os-br-view {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--background);
    container: br / inline-size;
  }
  .os-br-view > * {
    grid-area: 1 / 1;
  }
  .os-br-page {
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: auto;
  }
  .os-br-frame {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border: 0;
    background: #fff;
  }
  .os-br-view[data-mode='internal'] > .os-br-frame,
  .os-br-view[data-mode='web'] > .os-br-page {
    visibility: hidden;
  }
  .os-br-progress {
